# 74125 - Quadruple bus buffers with 3-state outputs

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74125.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74125.json)

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1G | enable | low |  | controls pins 3; when not enabled: float; output enable; high puts 1Y in the high-impedance state |
| 2 | 1A | input |  |  |  |
| 3 | 1Y | output |  | three-state | enabled by 1 |
| 4 | 2G | enable | low |  | controls pins 6; when not enabled: float; output enable; high puts 2Y in the high-impedance state |
| 5 | 2A | input |  |  |  |
| 6 | 2Y | output |  | three-state | enabled by 4 |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 8 | 3Y | output |  | three-state | enabled by 10 |
| 9 | 3A | input |  |  |  |
| 10 | 3G | enable | low |  | controls pins 8; when not enabled: float; output enable; high puts 3Y in the high-impedance state |
| 11 | 4Y | output |  | three-state | enabled by 13 |
| 12 | 4A | input |  |  |  |
| 13 | 4G | enable | low |  | controls pins 11; when not enabled: float; output enable; high puts 4Y in the high-impedance state |
| 14 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1Y = 1G' ? 1A : Z | 1Y follows 1A while 1G is low; high impedance while 1G is high. |
| 6 | 2Y = 2G' ? 2A : Z | 2Y follows 2A while 2G is low; high impedance while 2G is high. |
| 8 | 3Y = 3G' ? 3A : Z | 3Y follows 3A while 3G is low; high impedance while 3G is high. |
| 11 | 4Y = 4G' ? 4A : Z | 4Y follows 4A while 4G is low; high impedance while 4G is high. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 24 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -2.6 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | SN74LS125A figures (page 6); off-state current +/-20 uA. SN74125: IOL 16 mA, IOH -5.2 mA (page 5). |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | Y | PLH | 9 | 15 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 667 ohm, CL 45 pF |
| A | Y | PHL | 7 | 18 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 667 ohm, CL 45 pF |
| G | Y | PZH | 12 | 20 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 667 ohm, CL 45 pF |
| G | Y | PZL | 15 | 25 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 667 ohm, CL 45 pF |
| G | Y | PHZ |  | 20 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 667 ohm, CL 5 pF |
| G | Y | PLZ |  | 20 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 667 ohm, CL 5 pF |

## Not known

- The switching table does not name the input pins for each figure; A for tPLH/tPHL and G for the enable/disable times are taken from what those times mean.

## Notes

Timing is the SN74LS125A table (page 6). SN74125 (page 5, RL 400 ohm, CL 50 pF): tPLH 8/13, tPHL 12/18, tPZH 11/17, tPZL 16/25, tPHZ 5/8 (CL 5 pF), tPLZ 7/12 ns typ/max. Plain file: the lookup uses it for 74LS125 too. The datasheet's 'LS125A is the A version; the card drawing says 74LS125.

## Sources

- [TI SN54125/SN54126/SN54LS125A/SN54LS126A/SN74125/SN74126/SN74LS125A/SN74LS126A datasheet SDLS044A (December 1983, revised March 2002)](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74ls125a.pdf) - 1, 2, 5, 6; SN74LS125A
